Hi Samantha — great to meet you yesterday as well.

Short answer: usually yes, but it depends on the mechanism the sponsor wants to use. Two common patterns we support:

1) Sponsor pays invoice directly to Redwood (recommended): we create a single invoice for your account and accept sponsor payment as a line-item/credit. Sponsor paperwork (LOI + payment remittance) and standard vendor details are required.

2) Sponsor reimburses you (less common): Redwood issues invoice to Lumen, you bill BioVentures separately. Voucher stacking still possible but accounting stays between you and the sponsor.

Ben from finance is cc'd — he'll outline required documents and any restrictions (promo voucher transferability, tax forms). If you can share an estimate of monthly token/embedding consumption (even a range), I can propose a quick conversion example to show how credits apply and what a single invoice would look like.

Proposed next steps:
- Samantha: share sponsor name + payments contact + rough consumption estimate
- Procurement: attach W-9 if comfortable (we can accept after SOW in some cases but earlier is cleaner)
- Ben: confirm official paperwork list and timeline

I'll also loop in Marissa in ops to prepare an account/offer that includes the trial vouchers.

Thanks —

Hi Samantha (and team),

Thanks Connor — quick rundown from finance/legal on how we handle sponsor-backed credits vs. promotional trial vouchers:

Summary of constraints:
- Redwood trial vouchers are account-level promotional credits and are non-transferable. They apply only to the account they were issued to.
- Sponsor credits can be applied either by the sponsor paying Redwood directly (we mark the account with sponsor-funded credit) or via sponsor reimbursement to you.
- We do not allow the transfer of a Redwood promotional voucher to a third party; however, a sponsor payment + sponsor LOI can be applied as a separate credit balance on the same account, effectively stacking with trial vouchers.

Required paperwork when sponsor pays Redwood directly:
- Sponsor LOI / payment authorization (pdf) with payment terms
- Sponsor remittance details and billing contact
- Sponsor W-9 (or equivalent for non-US orgs) if Redwood will invoice them directly
- Customer SOW describing intended use and estimated consumption window

If sponsor reimburses customer instead, we will accept customer-provided proof of sponsor funding and will apply credits only after receiving cleared payment or an agreed escrow arrangement.

Attached templates: [Attachment: promo-stack-playbook.pdf (pdf)] and [Attachment: invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)] — these show examples of combined invoices and how line items will appear.

Timeline: once we have LOI + W-9 + SOW + payment remittance, finance can provision sponsor credit within 3–5 business days and Marissa will confirm account setup for voucher stacking.

Risks & notes:
- Tax treatment: if sponsor pays Redwood, Redwood treats that as customer revenue; we may need sponsor tax forms for reporting.
- Noncompliance: if paperwork is incomplete, we can't accept sponsor payment and credits may be delayed.

Samantha — happy to run a sample invoice for the numbers you share.

Regards,
Ben Carter
